title: Minecraft server (minecraft-exporter)
description: A Minecraft server through WorldAPI and minecraft-exporter: performance, worlds, players, activity, chat, and events.

list.name: worldapi
list.label: WorldAPI
list.description: An Infinity data source whose URL is your WorldAPI, for the chat and event tables

list.name: multiplayer
list.label: Multiplayer
list.description: Hidden: the rows that repeat over it show only on a server.

list.name: singleplayer
list.label: Singleplayer
list.description: Hidden: the rows that repeat over it show only for a singleplayer world.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Whether the exporter reached WorldAPI on its last scrape, and whether a singleplayer game is paused.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The server software (Paper, Fabric, or NeoForge), and the WorldAPI version, platform, and side in the tooltip's labels.

panels.title: TPS
panels.description: Ticks per second over the last minute; 20 is full speed. A paused singleplayer game doesn't tick, and Status says so.

panels.title: Tick time p95
panels.description: 95% of recent ticks took less. Past 50 ms the server falls behind.

panels.title: Heap
panels.description: Java heap in use, of its maximum. It saws up and down with garbage collection.

panels.title: Your world
panels.description: A singleplayer world with the WorldAPI mod: shown instead of the server's players, console, and chat.

panels.title: Game
panels.description: Whether the game runs or sits paused in its menu; a paused world doesn't tick.

panels.title: Play time
panels.description: Time played in this world.

panels.title: Level
panels.description: The experience level now.

panels.title: Deaths
panels.description: Deaths in this world.

panels.title: Diamonds mined
panels.description: Diamond ore mined, deepslate too.

panels.title: Advancements
panels.description: Advancements done, recipes aside.

panels.title: Health and food
panels.description: Health and food points, 20 each when full, while you play.

panels.title: Mods
panels.description: Mods in the game with their versions. Needs a WorldAPI token with server:read.

panels.title: TPS
panels.description: Ticks per second over one, five, and fifteen minutes; 20 is full speed.

panels.title: Tick time
panels.description: How long ticks take: the median, the slow ones, and the slowest. Past 50 ms (the red line) the server can't keep 20 TPS.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU in use across every core: the server's process, and the whole machine.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: Share of time each collector spends collecting. A few percent is normal; long pauses show up as tick spikes.

panels.title: Host
panels.description: The machine the server runs on, as WorldAPI sees it. Needs a WorldAPI token with system:read.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Processes running or waiting for a CPU. Above the CPU count (dashed), work queues up.

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: Memory in use on the machine, and how much of it the server's process holds.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Free space on the disk under the server folder, where the world grows.

panels.title: Open files
panels.description: Files and sockets the server holds open, against its limit.

panels.title: Entities
panels.description: Mobs, items, minecarts, and everything else that moves, in loaded chunks.

panels.title: Block entities
panels.description: Chests, hoppers, furnaces, and other blocks that keep data, in loaded chunks. Hoppers in bulk cost ticks.

panels.title: Most common entities
panels.description: Across every world, now. Dropped items or one mob type piling up usually means a farm or a lag source.

panels.title: Weather
panels.description: Clear, rain, or a thunderstorm in each world that has weather. Rain turns to snow in cold biomes.

panels.title: Day
panels.description: Days the overworld has lived.

panels.title: Time of day
panels.description: In the overworld, by the game's clock: a day lasts 20 minutes.

panels.title: Weather now
panels.description: The overworld's weather at the last scrape.

panels.title: Lag sources
panels.description: What crowds each world's loaded chunks. Needs a WorldAPI token with server:read.

panels.title: Items on the ground
panels.description: Dropped items, stacks added up. Thousands usually mean a farm without a collector.

panels.title: Villagers
panels.description: Villagers in loaded chunks. Trading halls and breeders cost ticks.

panels.title: Pets and named mobs
panels.description: Tamed animals and mobs with a name tag, which never despawn.

panels.title: Busiest chunks
panels.description: The chunks with the most entities in each world, now. The coordinates are chunk coordinates: multiply by 16 for blocks.

panels.title: Players ever
panels.description: Everyone who has joined the server at least once.

panels.title: Ping
panels.description: Each online player's ping, as the server measures it.

panels.title: Online now
panels.description: Who's online now, where, and how they're doing. Coordinates show only with a WorldAPI token, or when WorldAPI shows them to everyone.

targets.expr: max by (player) (clamp_min(minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} - (minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} offset $__range or minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} * 0), 0)) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}
max by (player) (minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}
max by (player) (minecraft_player_deaths_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}
max by (player) (minecraft_player_advancements{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}

panels.title: Every player
panels.description: Lifetime statistics from the game's own counters. Mined counts every block, Hearts lost the damage taken. Click a header to sort.

panels.title: Joins, deaths, advancements
panels.description: Each bar counts its slice of time.

panels.title: Played in this period
panels.description: Time each player spent online within the dashboard's time range.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (player) (clamp_min(minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} - (minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} offset $__range or minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} * 0), 0)) > 0)

panels.title: Mobs killed
panels.description: By player; each bar counts its slice of time.

panels.title: Blocks mined
panels.description: By player; each bar counts its slice of time.

panels.title: Distance traveled
panels.description: By player; each bar counts its slice of time.

panels.title: Deaths by cause
panels.description: Within the time range; a killer shows next to the cause when there was one.

panels.title: Chat by player
panels.description: Messages each player sent within the time range. Needs a WorldAPI token with chat:read.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (player) (clamp_min(minecraft_player_chat_messages_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} - (minecraft_player_chat_messages_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} offset $__range or minecraft_player_chat_messages_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} * 0), 0)) > 0)

panels.title: Other plugins' events
panels.description: Events other plugins share through WorldAPI and record: boss kills, level-ups, and the like. Each bar counts its slice of time.

panels.title: New players
panels.description: Players who joined for the first time; each bar counts its slice of time.

panels.title: Plugins and mods
panels.description: Plugins on the server, or mods on Fabric and NeoForge, with their versions. Needs a WorldAPI token with server:read.

panels.title: Console lines
panels.description: Lines the console printed, by level; each bar counts its slice of time.

panels.title: Warnings and errors by source
panels.description: Who logged warnings and errors within the time range: a plugin, Minecraft, or a library.

panels.title: Chat
panels.description: Chat messages within the time range, newest first. WorldAPI records them only with events.chat on, and shows them only to tokens with chat:read.

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Joins, deaths, advancements, and other moments within the time range, newest first.

panels.title: Console warnings and errors
panels.description: The newest warnings and errors the console printed since the server started. Needs a WorldAPI token with logs:read.

panels.title: Collections
panels.description: Garbage collections per minute, by collector.

panels.title: Scrape time
panels.description: How long the exporter took to read WorldAPI, a few player statistics included each time.

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: WorldAPI requests that failed, by endpoint: timeouts, errors, a server that's down. Missing permissions don't count; the table beside shows them.

panels.title: What the token can read
panels.description: Each WorldAPI endpoint the exporter uses, and whether its token may read it. Panels that need a closed endpoint stay empty.
